reason: The request has one preference: remove items that cause hunger. The phrase I'm not hungry is a negated personal state and does not negate the command, so the direction stays exclude. Hunger is caused by food content, so the food and cooking terms express the span even though no literal food word appears. Night market is only weakly food related (it is a place or travel term), so it is not selected. Music, repair and travel terms do not relate.

controls.intent_span: remove all the stuff that makes me hungry
controls.relation: Content that makes a person hungry is food content. Cooking, Baking, Home recipes and the tags baking, bread, dinner, recipe, salad and street food all name food or food preparation, so they clearly cover the span. Remove is an exclude command.
